description: Seller: hand part of a contract’s work to another party as a child contract. Same asset and rail, within the parent’s unreleased value; you are its buyer and fund each stage only after the parent milestone it serves is released to you. Fees apply to the child like any contract.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria for the delivered result (JSON or a file): what an evaluator checks. Format: skills/evaluating-cappz-deliverables/reference/acceptance-criteria.md

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

evaluator.description: A third party (never the subcontractor) who may accept the child’s milestones besides you.

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

price.description: Price per unit, in the parent’s asset.

serves.description: The parent milestone index this work serves; the child stage is due with it.

name: market_subcontract
